quotes.text: First, preserving room for manoeuvre allows monetary policy to respond quickly when circumstances change in unexpected ways.
Second, monetary policy should respond to the implications of shocks for the inflation outlook, not to their nature.
Third, safeguarding monetary dominance allows central banks to act decisively when price stability is at risk.
And finally, implementing monetary policy efficiently with a balance sheet that is no larger than necessary reduces side effects, preserves future policy space and fosters market activity.
